newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil re-election bill heads to lower house floor.
newsitem.headline: Brazil re-election bill heads to lower house floor.

text.p: A special committee of the Brazilian lower house Wednesday completed voting on proposed amendments to a bill on re-election and the law now passes to the full lower house floor, officials said.

Panel officials said deputies on the committee killed a proposal to make re-election dependent on a plebiscite and after that, both government and opposition deputies withdrew the remaining proposed amendments.
Earlier, the panel voted to approve the constitutional amendment on re-election itself.

The government hopes to present the bill, which would give President Fernando Henrique Cardoso a stab at a second term, to the Chamber of Deputies next week. But it was unclear whether the bill could progress that quickly.
